headline: Frequent Rework of Formatting Logic
diagnosis: The file src/black/__init__.py is undergoing repeated changes primarily related to formatting options and handling edge cases. The commit messages indicate a recurring theme of fixing issues with command-line options and output behavior, suggesting that the formatting logic is not robust enough to handle various scenarios.
plan: Conduct a thorough review of the formatting logic to identify edge cases that are not currently handled, especially related to command-line options like --skip-source-first-line and --quiet.
Implement comprehensive unit tests for each command-line option and edge case identified, ensuring that all scenarios are covered to prevent future regressions.
Refactor the relevant sections of the code to improve clarity and maintainability, focusing on reducing complexity and potential hidden coupling with other modules.
Establish a code review process that emphasizes testing and validation of formatting changes before merging, to minimize the likelihood of introducing new issues.
owner_hint: Ownership should be shared among the core team to reduce bus factor.
